# yagent

> AI agent platform for web and desktop. yagent works with real tools, makes execution visible, and preserves useful takeaways as Insights.

## Start here

- [Agent instructions](https://synclionpaw.github.io/yagent/agents.txt): setup, capabilities, verification commands, and safety boundaries.
- [Documentation](https://synclionpaw.github.io/yagent/docs.html): product setup and usage.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/synclionpaw/yagent): implementation, README, and design specification.

## Site

- [Home](https://synclionpaw.github.io/yagent/): product overview and real interface screenshots.
- [Pricing](https://synclionpaw.github.io/yagent/pricing.html): current plan presentation.

## Product facts

- Web and desktop interfaces
- Local and SSH working directories
- Multiple user-configured model providers
- Terminal and file tools, visible artifacts, project browsing, and structured questions
- Optional task-derived Insights

The website is a static product site, not a hosted agent runtime. Local setup requires Node.js 20+ and pnpm 10.0.0.
